node.title: loop iterator in a string
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Dear Monks,
I would like to use the ".." as a loop operator but in a string. Is there any simple perl-ish way I can accomplish this? For some reason, I thought perl would support this, but it doesn't. my $arr=[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]; my $loop="2,4..5"; splice @$arr,$_,0,999 foreach($loop);

I want $arr to be [1, 2, 999, 3, 999, 999, 4, 5, 6, 7]. This works fine if you pass in 2,4..5 instead of "2,4..5". I notice that '2', '4'..'5' will also work, but when the .. operator is within string, it does not.

Thank you for your time!

Michael
